name: Barbell Floor Press
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with knees bent and feet planted, holding a barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width above your chest.
Pull your shoulder blades down into the floor and brace your core tightly.
Lower the bar smoothly with elbows angled roughly 45 degrees until the backs of your upper arms touch the floor lightly.
Pause briefly without relaxing tension, then press the bar straight back up over your shoulders.
tips: Keep your forearms vertical directly under the bar at the bottom.
Touch the floor softly instead of slamming or bouncing your elbows off the ground.
